local_reproduction.environment: pure-Python reproduction of exact old/new trim and response-field logic

cases.name: system_growth_starves_history
cases.old_reference: 2 total messages remain = system + 1 history turn
cases.new_drive: 10 total messages remain = system + all 9 history turns

oracles.historical_mechanism: Frozen router counted system prompt and conversation against one 10,000-character budget and repeatedly removed oldest history while system text was retained. Drive source records measured system text of 8,691-12,253 chars and 0/9 conversation steps reaching the model under the failing condition.
oracles.required_current_behavior: Context budgets must be typed by semantic channel and derived from actual tokenizer/per-slot context. Growth in one retained channel must not silently zero another required channel without an explicit truncation/abstention receipt.

oracles.historical_mechanism: Drive cap 22,000 chars was derived from ctx-size 16,384 / parallel 2, reserved 2,048 output tokens and measured 3.86 chars/token.
oracles.required_current_behavior: A derived budget is valid only for the runtime configuration/tokenizer it was measured against; changing context size, parallel slots, tokenizer or response reserve must invalidate/recompute the budget instead of preserving a magic number as semantic truth.

oracles.historical_mechanism: Newer llama.cpp reasoning handling could place output in message.reasoning_content while message.content was empty; frozen router interpreted that as no answer and route() converted it into a 503. Drive source reports 6/6 observations under tight max_tokens before mitigation.
oracles.required_current_behavior: Provider/runtime response schemas must be versioned/validated and normalized before semantic success/failure classification. A field relocation must not turn valid model output into transport failure.

oracles.historical_mechanism: Drive applies the same context-trim helper to blocking and streaming paths.
oracles.required_current_behavior: Blocking and streaming variants of one semantic operation must share the same context/resource projection or differential tests must prove intended differences.

epistemic_boundary: The local reproduction establishes the logic-level failure and fix. Historical 0/9 and 6/6 counts are source-reported measurements, not independently replayed against the original llama-server configuration.
